name: Crosstalk cards
summary: A Settings switch, off for a new install: when a crosstalk message is delivered the server pushes one event and the receiving terminal shows a FROM card, the sending terminal a TO card. Nothing scans the terminal.
media_exempt: off by default; screenshot is captured before the next version bump
where: Settings, Terminal, crosstalk cards: switch it on; the other three switches are under it.
Open the terminal of an agent that sent or received a crosstalk message.
how_to: Switch "show crosstalk cards" on; a card appears on both terminals when a message is delivered.
Click a card to dismiss it; it also fades after twenty seconds.
Switch the sending or the receiving side off under it.
Switch on "keep cards until dismissed" (off by default) to keep each session's cards until you dismiss them, so they are still there when you switch tabs and back.
examples: A reply from a Codex agent shows a FROM card on your Claude terminal without leaving the conversation.
